ravi: grabbing maintenance slot ms-999 for shard split + id-type swap. start 2026-06-01T04:00:00Z. window 40m. plan: leader DDL, small backfill waves, runtime pinned to v2.17.0-rc.

deploybot: slot ms-999 created. start=2026-06-01T04:00:00Z window=40m owner=@ravi holdpoints=[preflight, canary-ok] autopause=8m

kelsey: canary plan: tenants t-small-7/8, workers=4, rate=600/s, db_conn_limit=110. will run schema-compat smoke T-30m.

toni: abort criteria: replication lag > 50s for 3m OR deadlock count >=2 in 10m OR table-locks > 4s on >=3 hosts. these are stricter than usual because split can amplify locks.

ravi: short rollback steps for ops-runbook:
```
1) pause backfill: `./ctl/mig pause --slot ms-999`
2) enable write-block: `ff set tenant_id_migration_block on`
3) unpin service: `infractl pin api v2.16.9` (fallback)
4) revert DDL if safe: `psql -f revert/ms-999.sql`
5) notify #oncall and attach deploybot.audit id`
```

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-999.preflight. waiting for :white_check_mark: from @kelsey @toni

kelsey: preflight smoke passed. pg_locks sample looks clean. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: canary wave started. wave=1/3 targets=[t-small-7,t-small-8] rate=600 workers=4

toni: watching locks and deadlocks. setting temporary ps alert: page if deadlocks >=1. (we can relax after canary).

deploybot: canary complete. metrics: errors=0.09% replication_peak=30s p99 latency +4ms. vote CONTINUE or ABORT.

kelsey: +1 continue but keep autopause holdpoint until T+12m observation.

ravi: note: if unpin blocks due to orchestrator lease we'll instead flip routing to read-fallback and scale read replicas x2 for 5m, then retry unpin. documented in ops playbook.

deploybot: full-wave started. wave=2/3 queued=7 workers=6 rate=600

toni: observed a 5.2s table lock on shard-2 during wave 2, below threshold but taking note.

kelsey: replication peaked 46s on replica-1 during wave 2; within abort threshold but close. continuing with caution.

ravi: lowering batch size to 150 for last wave to reduce lock contention.

deploybot: wave=3/3 started. queued=4 workers=5

toni: deadlock detected on shard-5 (1 instance). below abort threshold but we should watch for recurrence.

kelsey: continuing, holdpoint still active. if we see a second deadlock within 8m we execute rollback steps.

deploybot: slot ms-999 complete. status=partial-success. aggregate errors=0.21% replication_peak=49s. holdpoint still open for final observation. logs archived s3://redwood-ms/ms-999/ deploybot.audit=ddb-3523456789

ravi: thanks team. will capture pg_locks snapshots every 30s for postrun artifacts and open follow-up for tuning batch sizes. closing once holdpoint expires :white_check_mark:
